english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for directing a device or person and for keeping an impulse or situation in check.
This is the all-purpose choice for controlling a person, situation, or outcome, including overwhelming influence.
Use this as the broad everyday verb for controlling a situation, group, system, or movement.
Use this for controlling, limiting, or restraining enthusiasm, a force, or a person.
Use this when guide means exert control or influence over a person, situation, or affair.
Use this when governing means keeping behaviour or a process under control.
